correction_ledger.finding: Smart Topology API rejects image_enhancement even when false
correction_ledger.cause: HTTP 400, no task created, zero reserved credits
correction_ledger.correction: Remove unsupported field and use reference-project request settings in smart_topology_v2
Rebalanced part budgets and added sleeve extent assertion; head retains 2250 faces.
Local inverse-edge smoothing and normalized strongest four runtime influences; source arm motion retained.

correction_ledger.finding: Cloth chain rotation accumulation and strain
correction_ledger.correction: Baked translated joints with strain and body/floor constraints; removed hidden rear tunic surface.

correction_ledger.resolution: Repacked head UVs with isolated problem triangles, paid head_retexture_v2, verified zero overlap and exact face/corner transfer.
Distributed local quaternion/location closure; final exported maximum cyclic difference 1.20 mm, near-zero numerical floor penetration.

correction_ledger.finding: Native palette classification, speckle and sword region leakage
correction_ledger.resolution: Classified olive cloak by native hue, kept collar/leather invariant, smoothed cloth albedo, cleared and padded rigid sword swatches; actual glTF UV samples verify zero sword region mask.

correction_ledger.finding: User: lower tabard twitches erratically in every animation.
correction_ledger.resolution: Replaced independent translation corrections with a pinned waist, shared bending curve, smooth time envelope, and articulated floor contact during the fall. Runtime GLB verified between frames.

correction_ledger.finding: User: texture appears to bleed through belt.
correction_ledger.resolution: Confirmed actual shirt/belt surface intersections; tucked and pelvis-weighted the covered waist surface, tightened the fit, and removed the green/red paint contamination from the leather belt.

correction_ledger.finding: User: left hand has strange anatomy.
correction_ledger.resolution: Reshaped palm and knuckle arc, corrected finger and thumb lengths/volume, refitted finger joints, and keyed a relaxed curl. Left-hand stretch maximum is 1.22x across all eight clips.

correction_ledger.finding: Agent observed collar/capelet intersecting the head in the prone corpse pose during browser frame review.
correction_ledger.diagnosis: The apparent missing/intersecting head in close-up corpse views was stale Three.js skinned-mesh frustum bounds, confirmed against the intact authoring geometry.
correction_ledger.resolution: Disable frustum culling for skinned meshes in the single-creature review viewer; verified the same close cameras show the complete head.

correction_ledger.finding: User: feet tilt above the ground and warp during idle and walking.
correction_ledger.resolution: Rigid shoe weights remove calf/toe deformation from the soles. Baked two-bone leg contact keeps planted soles flat and preserves heel strike, toe-off and swing clearance. Corrective motion is sampled at 120 Hz without changing clip durations; the exported model was checked at 240 Hz.

correction_ledger.finding: User: angular dark artifacts on the upper back during death.
correction_ledger.resolution: The overlapping cloak and mantle had different deformation weights, exposing the dark covered layer. They now share a continuous chest/shoulder field, with neck flex confined to the upright collar. Death and Dead were visually checked in the viewer and native game.

correction_ledger.finding: Additional pre-existing boots protruding through the lower cloak during the fall.
correction_ledger.resolution: A smooth, bounded clearance arch lifts the falling cloak over the boots and settles before Dead. Exported vertical clearance samples at 120 Hz show no breakthrough with a 4 mm margin.

correction_ledger.finding: User: left shoulder shirt breaks through the mantle during walking.
correction_ledger.resolution: Matched the covered shoulder shirt to the mantle deformation with smooth sleeve transitions. Actual export: 18 probes across 1,224 poses at 120 Hz retain at least 5.25 mm coverage; original Walking breached by 7.36 mm.

correction_ledger.finding: User: waist ornament/buckle appears to sway independently.
correction_ledger.resolution: Confirmed buckle and belt already share rigid pelvis weights; shared hip sway is intentional. Removed duplicate painted buckle/imprint from shirt and belt through clean fabric/leather UV reuse, and seated the metal medallion 28 mm lower on the broad belt. Attachment error below 0.001 mm.

correction_ledger.finding: User: resemble supplied sword concept, mainly broader tip and slight upper blade flare, with modest triangle cost.
correction_ledger.resolution: Rebuilt only the blade profile with seven diamond cross sections; retained 112 hilt vertices and the Sword joint. Complete sword 232 -> 256 triangles; main body vertex/index/skin arrays and every animation channel unchanged.

references_head.name: 00_front.png
references_head.prompt:
Generate a close-up head-turnaround reference of this EXACT MM6 Swordsman. Input 1 is the accepted full-body front, input 2 the accepted full-body three-quarter. Same adult human man's facial identity: stern broad mature face, thick grey moustache only, clean shaven chin, silver-grey centre-parted straight shoulder-length hair, natural skin. Do not rejuvenate, beautify, grow a beard, add headgear or change proportions.
ONE bust, straight-on front, head and neck facing exactly toward the camera, near orthographic. Crop the bust beneath the collar at the upper chest: include ALL hair, ears, neck and the raised red-and-gold collar plus a small edge of olive shoulder capelet. Preserve the native design, no added objects. Face occupies most of the image with generous margins around the hair. Desired square canvas 1254x1254, output at native generated resolution with no resizing. Even diffuse neutral lighting, no hard shadows or rim glow, true transparent background, no floor, text, labels or extra panels. Detailed 3D game-character materials consistent with the body references; the purpose is a faithful head-only texture reference.
